title: Minimum Cost to Move Chips to The Same Position
summary: Given n chips at various positions, determine the least cost to align all chips at a single position.
statement: Given n chips at various positions, determine the least cost to align all chips at a single position. Moves by two positions cost nothing, while moves by one position cost one unit.
constraints: Moving by two costs zero and moving by one costs one.
reference_solution:
def minimum_chip_move_cost(position):
 even=sum(value%2==0 for value in position);return min(even,len(position)-even)
hints: Free two-step moves collapse all even positions together and all odd positions together.
Only crossing from one parity to the other costs one per chip.
Count even and odd positions and move the smaller group.
Any common destination has one parity, so exactly the opposite-parity chips must pay once.
editorial: Any common destination has one parity, so exactly the opposite-parity chips must pay once.

tests.explanation: Move chips at one and three together for free, then move the chip at two once.
Moving the two odd-position chips to an even position costs two.
